# Harbor Ventures — Group Profile

Harbor Ventures is a investment group group headquartered in Singapore, founded in 1990.
The CEO of Harbor Ventures is Sofia Alvarez.

# Meridian Group — Group Profile

Meridian Group is a conglomerate group headquartered in London, founded in 1985.
The CEO of Meridian Group is David Kim.

# Northgate Holdings — Group Profile

Northgate Holdings is a industrial holdings group headquartered in Chicago, founded in 1978.
The CEO of Northgate Holdings is Grace Lee.

# Copperline Mining — Company Profile

Copperline Mining operates in the mining sector and is headquartered in Perth. It was founded in 1998. Copperline Mining is a subsidiary of Harbor Ventures. The CEO of Copperline Mining is Sam Okoro.

# Fieldstone AgTech — Company Profile

Fieldstone AgTech operates in the agriculture software sector and is headquartered in Des Moines. It was founded in 2013. Fieldstone AgTech is a subsidiary of Northgate Holdings. The CEO of Fieldstone AgTech is Diego Fuentes.

# Harbor Grid — Company Profile

Harbor Grid operates in the energy distribution sector and is headquartered in Rotterdam. It was founded in 2004. Harbor Grid is a subsidiary of Harbor Ventures. The CEO of Harbor Grid is Ingrid Halvorsen.

# Ivory Lane — Company Profile

Ivory Lane operates in the payments sector and is headquartered in Dublin. It was founded in 2012. Ivory Lane is a subsidiary of Meridian Group. The CEO of Ivory Lane is Farah Aziz.

# Keystone Optics — Company Profile

Keystone Optics operates in the photonics sector and is headquartered in Zurich. It was founded in 2009. Keystone Optics is a subsidiary of Harbor Ventures. The CEO of Keystone Optics is Chen Wei.

# Lantern Media — Company Profile

Lantern Media operates in the streaming sector and is headquartered in Melbourne. It was founded in 2014. Lantern Media is a subsidiary of Harbor Ventures. The CEO of Lantern Media is Ruby O'Connell.

# Northgate Robotics — Company Profile

Northgate Robotics operates in the automation sector and is headquartered in Detroit. It was founded in 2005. Northgate Robotics is a subsidiary of Northgate Holdings. The CEO of Northgate Robotics is Hana Yoshida.

# Polar Computing — Company Profile

Polar Computing operates in the hardware sector and is headquartered in Helsinki. It was founded in 2006. Polar Computing is a subsidiary of Meridian Group. The CEO of Polar Computing is Jonah Pryce.

# Solstice Foods — Company Profile

Solstice Foods operates in the food brands sector and is headquartered in Lyon. It was founded in 2008. Solstice Foods is a subsidiary of Meridian Group. The CEO of Solstice Foods is Marcus Bell.

# Summit Rail — Company Profile

Summit Rail operates in the rail logistics sector and is headquartered in Oslo. It was founded in 2002. Summit Rail is a subsidiary of Northgate Holdings. The CEO of Summit Rail is Nils Andersen.

# Titan Materials — Company Profile

Titan Materials operates in the composites sector and is headquartered in Leeds. It was founded in 2001. Titan Materials is a subsidiary of Meridian Group. The CEO of Titan Materials is Elena Marsh.

# Vault & Ledger — Company Profile

Vault & Ledger operates in the fintech infrastructure sector and is headquartered in Frankfurt. It was founded in 2010. Vault & Ledger is a subsidiary of Northgate Holdings. The CEO of Vault & Ledger is Clara Winter.

# Amber Casino Group — Leadership Timeline

Amber Casino Group, a hospitality company based in Valletta founded in 2003, is a subsidiary of Meridian Group. Lena Fischer served as CEO of Amber Casino Group from 2017 to 2023. From 2023 onwards, Omar Haddad has served as CEO of Amber Casino Group.

# Basalt Cement — Leadership Timeline

Basalt Cement, a construction materials company based in Athens founded in 2000, is a subsidiary of Harbor Ventures. Nia Petrov served as CEO of Basalt Cement from 2015 to 2021. From 2021 onwards, Hugo Marino has served as CEO of Basalt Cement.

# Drift & Anchor — Leadership Timeline

Drift & Anchor, a maritime software company based in Lisbon founded in 2007, is a subsidiary of Northgate Holdings. Paulo Alves served as CEO of Drift & Anchor from 2014 to 2020. From 2020 onwards, Marta Kim has served as CEO of Drift & Anchor.

# Fable Studios — Leadership Timeline

Fable Studios, a animation company based in Copenhagen founded in 2011, is a subsidiary of Meridian Group. Iris Nova served as CEO of Fable Studios from 2016 to 2022. From 2022 onwards, Kenji Watanabe has served as CEO of Fable Studios.

# Pinecrest Timber — Leadership Timeline

Pinecrest Timber, a forestry company based in Vancouver founded in 1995, is a subsidiary of Northgate Holdings. Erik Strand served as CEO of Pinecrest Timber from 2013 to 2019. From 2019 onwards, Ava Whitecloud has served as CEO of Pinecrest Timber.

# Quillon Energy — Leadership Timeline

Quillon Energy, a offshore services company based in Stavanger founded in 1999, is a subsidiary of Harbor Ventures. Nora Berg served as CEO of Quillon Energy from 2015 to 2021. From 2021 onwards, Tomas Ruiz has served as CEO of Quillon Energy.

# Executive Biography: Chen Wei

Chen Wei is the CEO of Keystone Optics. Before taking the role, Chen Wei worked at Keystone Optics from 2015 to 2022.

# Executive Biography: Clara Winter

Clara Winter is the CEO of Vault & Ledger. Before taking the role, Clara Winter worked at Vault & Ledger from 2010 to 2018.

# Executive Biography: Diego Fuentes

Diego Fuentes is the CEO of Fieldstone AgTech. Before taking the role, Diego Fuentes worked at Fieldstone AgTech from 2014 to 2021.

# Executive Biography: Elena Marsh

Elena Marsh is the CEO of Titan Materials. Before taking the role, Elena Marsh worked at Meridian Group from 2012 to 2019.

# Executive Biography: Farah Aziz

Farah Aziz is the CEO of Ivory Lane. Before taking the role, Farah Aziz worked at Ivory Lane from 2014 to 2021.

# Executive Biography: Hana Yoshida

Hana Yoshida is the CEO of Northgate Robotics. Before taking the role, Hana Yoshida worked at Northgate Robotics from 2012 to 2019.

# Executive Biography: Ingrid Halvorsen

Ingrid Halvorsen is the CEO of Harbor Grid. Before taking the role, Ingrid Halvorsen worked at Harbor Grid from 2013 to 2020.

# Executive Biography: Jonah Pryce

Jonah Pryce is the CEO of Polar Computing. Before taking the role, Jonah Pryce worked at Polar Computing from 2010 to 2018.

# Executive Biography: Marcus Bell

Marcus Bell is the CEO of Solstice Foods. Before taking the role, Marcus Bell worked at Solstice Foods from 2011 to 2019.

# Executive Biography: Nils Andersen

Nils Andersen is the CEO of Summit Rail. Before taking the role, Nils Andersen worked at Summit Rail from 2008 to 2016.

# Executive Biography: Ruby O'Connell

Ruby O'Connell is the CEO of Lantern Media. Before taking the role, Ruby O'Connell worked at Lantern Media from 2016 to 2023.

# Executive Biography: Sam Okoro

Sam Okoro is the CEO of Copperline Mining. Before taking the role, Sam Okoro worked at Copperline Mining from 2009 to 2017.

# Product Note: Copperline Assay Kit

Copperline Assay Kit is a assay kit produced by Copperline Mining.

# Product Note: Fieldstone Yield OS

Fieldstone Yield OS is a agri OS produced by Fieldstone AgTech.

# Product Note: GridNode Controller

GridNode Controller is a grid controller produced by Harbor Grid.

# Product Note: Ivory Rail API

Ivory Rail API is a payments rail produced by Ivory Lane. It has been in production since 2019.

# Product Note: Keystone Lens Array

Keystone Lens Array is a optics module produced by Keystone Optics. It has been in production since 2018.

# Product Note: Lantern Stream Engine

Lantern Stream Engine is a streaming engine produced by Lantern Media.

# Product Note: Northgate Arm X2

Northgate Arm X2 is a robot arm produced by Northgate Robotics. It has been in production since 2020.

# Product Note: PolarCore Server

PolarCore Server is a edge server produced by Polar Computing.

# Product Note: Solstice Harvest

Solstice Harvest is a food line produced by Solstice Foods.

# Product Note: Summit Freight OS

Summit Freight OS is a rail OS produced by Summit Rail.

# Product Note: TitanWeave Panel

TitanWeave Panel is a composite panel produced by Titan Materials. It has been in production since 2016.

# Product Note: VaultGate Gateway

VaultGate Gateway is a banking gateway produced by Vault & Ledger. It has been in production since 2017.

# Product Line Note: Ivory Rail API X

Ivory Rail API X is a payments rail produced by Ivory Lane. The line launched in 2022 and remains in production.

# Product Line Note: Keystone Lens Array 2

Keystone Lens Array 2 is a optics module produced by Keystone Optics. The line launched in 2023 and remains in production.

# Product Line Note: Northgate Arm X3

Northgate Arm X3 is a robot arm produced by Northgate Robotics. The line launched in 2024 and remains in production.

# Product Line Note: TitanWeave Panel Pro

TitanWeave Panel Pro is a composite panel produced by Titan Materials. The line launched in 2021 and remains in production.

# Deal Brief: Meridian Group acquired Bastion Trust

In 2021, Meridian Group acquired Bastion Trust: trust services absorbed by Ivory Lane.

# Deal Brief: Meridian Group acquired Cranberry Labs

In 2023, Meridian Group acquired Cranberry Labs: food-science lab folded into Solstice Foods.

# Deal Brief: Northgate Holdings acquired Furrow Data

In 2023, Northgate Holdings acquired Furrow Data: field-data platform folded into Fieldstone AgTech.

# Deal Brief: Harbor Ventures acquired Gullwing Logistics

In 2021, Harbor Ventures acquired Gullwing Logistics: last-mile network merged into Summit Rail.

# Deal Brief: Meridian Group acquired Halcyon Coatings

In 2019, Meridian Group acquired Halcyon Coatings: coatings maker folded into Titan Materials.

# Deal Brief: Northgate Holdings acquired Ironwood Controls

In 2020, Northgate Holdings acquired Ironwood Controls: controls maker merged into Northgate Robotics.

# Deal Brief: Harbor Ventures acquired Prisma Analytics

In 2022, Harbor Ventures acquired Prisma Analytics: analytics team folded into Lantern Media.

# Deal Brief: Harbor Ventures acquired Tidewater Instruments

In 2018, Harbor Ventures acquired Tidewater Instruments: marine instruments merged into Harbor Grid.
